cases.name: Redis: entries written by one runtime are read, touched and purged by the other
Memcached: the extension's value format, compressed and not
Hazelcast: envelopes over the Memcached protocol
Filesystem: files written by one runtime are read by the other
Redis leases: a purge by one runtime rejects the other's stale save
Redis leases with a grace window: a tombstone stamped by one runtime holds for the other
Multiplexing and Redis share entries and leases
Sharding: both runtimes place a key on the same shard
